title: Red Hat Security Advisory: RHTAS 1.5.1 - Red Hat Trusted Artifact Signer Release
description: CVE-2026-19534 is a security vulnerability related to the Red Hat Trusted Artifact Signer (RHTAS) Operator used with OpenShift Container Platform versions 4.17 through 5.0. The vulnerability involves a flaw in the undici HTTP client library where custom TLS certificate validation functions are discarded during internal configuration, potentially allowing attackers to bypass custom cryptographic protections such as certificate or public-key pinning. This could enable interception or modification of encrypted communications if an attacker is positioned on the network. The vulnerability does not affect standard system trust stores or default certificate validations, limiting exposure to environments using specialized certificate validation handlers. Red Hat has released RHTAS version 1.5.1, but no explicit fix addressing this vulnerability is mentioned in the advisory. No known exploits are reported in the wild.
